description: Search the web: Google-quality results re-ranked for authority, merged with papers (arXiv), GitHub and news when the query needs them; optional category. Use it to find pages; with read=N it also returns the full clean text of the top N pages; with research=true it reads up to 8 pages and extracts the passages that answer the query, with sources. For one known URL use web_read instead. Price: results only $0.006, read 1-5 pages $0.015, research $0.05. Returns titles, URLs, snippets (and page markdown with a prompt-injection verdict per page). Live results; 1-15 s. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.

category.description: Optional: favor one kind of source (results-only mode).

limit.description: Results to return in results-only mode (default 10).

read.description: Pages to read in full (0 = results only, default 0).

region.description: Country code for results, e.g. us, uk, de, es (default us).

research.description: true = research mode: read up to 8 pages and return key passages ($0.05).

name: web_search
title: Web search (optionally read the top pages)
